versions.changelog:
Initial release: Instantly generate 7-day or 30-day social media content calendars for any niche.

- Creates structured, ready-to-schedule calendars with hooks, copy, CTAs, and hashtags per post.
- Supports JSON, human-readable, and CSV output formats for use with popular schedulers.
- Enforces content variety, rotates educational, proof, objection, community, and CTA post types.
- Platform-aware formatting for LinkedIn, Facebook, X, and Instagram.
- Free tier: 7-day demo/sample, plus compliance word checks; Premium: 30-day, multi-platform, variants, CSV.
- Fully configurable via command-line options (niche, audience, platform, theme, tone, and more).
